title: Network Groups
constraints: 1 ≤ n, m ≤ 10^5; 1 ≤ u, v ≤ n (self-links and repeated links allowed)
hints: Re-running a traversal after every new link repeats almost all of the work.
Keep a representative for each group; a new link either merges two groups or does nothing.
Union by size plus path compression makes each operation nearly constant time.
